channel.title: Azure Cosmos DB on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure Cosmos DB on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Throughput buckets in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB throughput buckets are now generally available. They let you cap the maximum throughput a workload can consume within the same container, helping manage resource usage across multiple workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Semantic Reranker in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now generally available supports a Semantic Reranker for search, which reorders candidate results using an AI model that considers the meaning of the query and surrounding context. The feature is intended to improve relevance by promoting better-matching documents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub real-time performance dashboards
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub now provides built-in, real-time performance dashboards for Microsoft SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, and Azure Cosmos DB. The dashboards are accessible from the Performance page and consolidate monitoring in one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-assisted data modeler and other updates in Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code now includes a public preview AI-assisted Data Modeler. It helps design data models earlier by analyzing document structure, query patterns, write distribution, expected scale, and data growth.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Embedding generation in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now offers public preview of built-in embedding generation. The feature converts content into vector embeddings using Azure Data-developed models to support semantic search and retrieval.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed MCP Server in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now has a public preview of a managed, hosted MCP server for connecting enterprise AI agents to business data through a standard MCP endpoint. The preview supports schema discovery, document retrieval, and full-text/vector search.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. It adds vaulted backups with immutable copies stored in an Azure Backup vault, separate from the source Cosmos DB account and managed through Azure Backup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB full-text search BM25 score projection
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB full-text search now supports BM25 score projection in generally available form. Applications can retrieve the relevance score for each result to make search ranking more transparent.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust is now generally available, providing a native Rust client for Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL. It supports direct database operations from Rust with built-in performance optimizations and failure handling.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Shell
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Shell is now generally available. It provides a command-line, scriptable workflow for working with Azure Cosmos DB, including support for AI agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Managed Redis database integration guidance
item.description:
Azure has launched generally available guidance for integrating Azure Managed Redis with Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL. The update provides caching guidance, reference architectures, and related materials for application integration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub in Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub is now generally available. It provides a unified place to discover, manage, monitor, and optimize databases across SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and Fabric SQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation is now generally available. It adds timestamp metadata for when each account key was last used, which helps identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates
